why: A lawsuit asking a California court to freeze frontier model development at five leading labs could, if granted, affect the next models readers build with. Public Citizen's release is the primary source, and CBS News, Common Dreams and Just Security covered it within two days. No story of the last 14 days covers litigation over AI safety. The claims are allegations, so the story is marked sensitive and needs the defendants' replies.
